description: A small white drawer-unit-like box sits on a red bedspread in front of you, with a loose drawer piece to the right once removed. The left hand steadies the box as a left-hand object, while the right hand moves in from the right to grasp the middle drawer knob and pull the drawer straight outward toward the right, turning it into a right-hand object; the right hand then carries the drawer further right and sets it down, releasing it while the left hand continues holding the box.
